messages.subject: RPostgreSQL error with PostgreSQL 'infinity' values in datetime data types
messages.subject_clean: RPostgreSQL error with PostgreSQL 'infinity' values in datetime data types
messages.body_plain:
I'm trying to use RPostgreSQL to select from a table that uses the 
PostgreSQL 'infinity' keyword in some fields (documentation 
<http://www.postgresql.org/docs/9.4/static/datatype-datetime.html>).  When 
attempting this, I get the following errors:

Error in charToDate(x) : 
  character string is not in a standard unambiguous format


 Error in as.POSIXlt.character(x, tz, ...) : 
  character string is not in a standard unambiguous format

Has anyone else encountered this problem? Should I submit an issue for this 
project?

Best,

Michael
